item.tib: rgya gar yul gyi mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'gal 'khrul nyes pa ci mchis pa/ ma sring byams pa'i tshogs la bshags/ 'di bzhengs dge ba rmad du byung*/ bdag dang 'gro drug bon nyid dbyings/ spros dang bral ba ye rdzogs smon/ kha ba can du bstan pa'i dpal/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bde legs mchog nub pa med pa'i bkra shis shog/
